extension.description: Live prompt-cache TTL countdown for Claude Code. Keeps the cache warm so TTL expiry doesn't burn your usage limit, shows your real 5h/7d subscription usage, and recommends 5m vs 1h from your real turn rhythm.
command.toggleMode.title: Claude TTL: Toggle cache mode
command.installAdvisorSkill.title: Claude TTL: Install /ttl-advisor skill (ask Claude)
command.connectSubscriptionUsage.title: Claude TTL: Connect subscription usage (real 5h/7d)
command.refreshSubscriptionUsage.title: Claude TTL: Refresh subscription usage now
config.subscriptionUsage.enabled: Show real 5h/7d subscription usage. When on, the extension sends one GET request per poll interval to https://api.anthropic.com/api/oauth/usage with the Claude Code login token already stored on this machine (~/.claude/.credentials.json, or the macOS Keychain). Nothing else is sent. Off by default.
config.subscriptionUsage.pollIntervalSec: How often to refresh subscription usage, in seconds (20-600). A refresh also runs right after each completed turn.
